scope: Dated supplemental primary risk relationships for the 15 native controls with empty risk_ids. Original September 2/11 registry remains historical; this adds no applicability or performed-control claim.

mappings.rationale: Engagement acceptance establishes authorized scope and terms.
Staffing plans address competence and delivery capacity.
Independent deliverable review prevents unsupported assurance.
Closeout records retention and customer data return.
Host and operator responsibilities need explicit authority.
Measurement and host reconciliation support settlement accounting.
Custody and settlement commitments require support and approval.
External host operating authority must be preserved.
Code distribution and attestation implement conduct policy.
Conflict review addresses compromised commitment authority.
Independent speak-up channels expose withheld governance information.
Fraud and related-party review address misstatement risk.
Nonstandard customer promises require authorized commitment ownership.
Recurring incidents must lead to corrective action.
Incident command and preserved evidence support disruption response.
